title: repro run gives every instance the same areas, budget, gate and starting state
goal: repro run rotates the area order per instance and starts no area its remaining cap cannot cover; a timed-out area's cost counts toward the instance budget; each area starts without auto-memory, a previous area's ignored scratch or the orchestrator's KB_ROOTS; repro records whether --max-turns bound each session and names an error_max_turns result a turns failure; repro run refuses a changed frozen file and names the claude binary its instances start
